relationships_information.note: Exact relationship edges are source-owned shards. Exact information claims, deliveries, holder knowledge, and delivery participation are deterministic shards; state/reg/information-deliveries.json is bounded routing/count metadata only.

reputation_subject.note: Known subject -> load subject record, then only the audience profile relevant to the observer. No audience profile means no stored audience reputation.

recognition_check.note: Combine direct personal knowledge with only the observer-accessible audience profile. Never infer universal fame.

reputation_event.note: Underlying world event first. Reputation event is perception/history; propagate through existing information routes and update delivered audiences only.

reputation_history.note: Cold causal history. Load only for provenance, dispute, or pending propagation.

family_person.note: Known person -> person_index -> only referenced union/household/kinship/parentage/succession records. Do not load whole family state.

family_transition.note: Courtship/proposal/betrothal/marriage/adoption/guardianship/dissolution use sparse authority plus only causal relationship, health, law/property and reputation owners.

family_succession.note: Kinship is eligibility evidence, never automatic title/property transfer. Load the exact succession record and its cited rule owners.

family_event.note: Cold provenance only. Use existing life-course/institution clocks; no family-only global clock.

family_kinship.note: Direct recognized kinship when parentage cannot be reconstructed without invention. Parent-child truth remains in parentage; feelings remain relationship state.

information_delivery.note: Route a known delivery id deterministically to exact delivery authority; sender/recipient participation is separately routed under holder knowledge directories.

information_claim.note: Route a known claim id deterministically to its exact claim shard. The root information file is not claim authority.

information_holder.note: Bounded holder index routes complete claim-membership and delivery-participation buckets without global scans.
